semantic_fields.summary: System One decision models score candidate actions rather than generate unrestricted text. CLM adds an open implementation to the existing Jev evidence.
semantic_fields.why_now: A pre-cutoff CLM README describes separately encoded states and actions, typed decisions and candidate ranking.
semantic_fields.practical_value: A distinct implementation helps investigate routing and verification without treating every decision as a text-generation task.
semantic_fields.limitations: Both projects report their own results. CLM scores supplied candidates; its displayed coding-verifier results involve fine-tuning. No performance or calibration claim was reproduced.
semantic_fields.next_action: Compare decision quality and calibration on identical candidate sets; distinguish the reference checkpoint from task-tuned verifier heads.
